text: MOC-2019-021 review, corrective actions from the november seal failure. Dana walk us through it

three changes. one: 20LFC20CL101, low-low level trip on 20LFC20BB001 that stops both 20LFC20AP001 and 20LFC20AP002. two: check valves 20LFC20AA011 and 20LFC20AA012 on the pump discharges. three: 20LFC20CF101, low-flow alarm on the reflux
why the check valves? the incident was level, not backflow
with one pump tripped and the other running you can get flow going backwards through the stopped one. cheap to prevent
same as our other trips. ill add it to the test schedule
what does the operator see when it trips
pumps stop, alarm on the console. 20LFC20CF101 will already be going off since reflux flow drops
ok good. ill brief the crews
no objections. approved. drawing goes to Rev 1
